en.title: Recover an Array from Sums Excluding Each Element
en.description:
pref[i] equals the sum of all elements of the original array except the i-th one. Recover the original array. This site guarantees that an integer solution exists and that N is at least 2; N=1 cannot be determined uniquely, so it is not part of this protocol.

This site uses a standard input/output protocol; missing numeric ranges are stated explicitly.
en.input: The first line contains N, and the second line contains N values pref. The source has no numeric ranges; this site uses 2≤N≤100000 and −10⁹≤pref[i]≤10⁹, and an integer solution is guaranteed to exist.
en.output: Output N integers in original index order.
en.explanation: Example 1: the total is 6, and the answer is 4, 0, 2. Example 2: the total is 14, and the answer is 3, 5, 6. Example 3: with two elements, each pref is the other element, so the answer is 5, −3.
hints: Each original element is counted N−1 times, so the total is T=sum(pref)/(N−1), and each answer is T−pref[i].
